So..... there are basically two end game scenarios for me at this point.
3rd - Gersh 12/17/2025 4:59 PM

Scenario A (F3: Me, CJ, SM)

In both cases I think it's safe to say at this point CJ and SM will probably be voting for Courtney as long as she doesn't win immunity. In this scenario I keep my head down, vote with them and leave the opportunity open to pitch to either of them next round if they win immunity. But with a lot less certainty of making it to the end. I feel like CJ shouldn't want to have to argue against a lawyer at FTC but you never know with him. And I would think just based on their working relationship Small Might probably skews more towards taking CJ to the end? Basically this path I have my work cut out for me.
3rd - Gersh 12/17/2025 5:07 PM

Scenario B (F3: Me, CJ and Courtney)

In this scenario I try to save Courtney this round by giving her fire. I probably burn some bridges with CJ and SM in this case and this is still hinged on Courtney then winning firemaking to get to F3. Where here I'm probably guaranteed FTC, CJ does not take courtney to the end and Courtney has told me multiple times now she wants to sit with me at the end. That security would be nice and while I feel I have the resume to beat Courtney at the end. I can not ignore the public narrative that has been pushed for rounds now. I probably beat CJ but I do not beat Courtney. She can tell me she's gonna shut down people not hearing me out and that she doesn't for sure have Adam or Sauls votes to win, but I don't know if I buy it. I can't put myself in a position to be completely dismissed yet again by this cast. JM flat out told me he will not entertain the idea of voting for me against her, and honestly he's probably not the only one.
